Who We Are | Compass Group Recruiting Who We Are Who We Aren't Why Compass Meet the Team WHO WE ARE Built for American manufacturing. Compass Group Recruiting is a specialized manufacturing recruiting company built around a simple standard: tell the truth, do the work, and do the right thing for the employer and the candidate — even when doing the right thing costs us a fee. WHAT COMPASS STANDS FOR Manufacturing is not one of the things we recruit for. It's the ONLY thing we recruit for. We believe strong American manufacturing matters. The companies making, machining, molding, welding, automating and improving products across this country need talented people — and those people deserve recruiters who understand the work. We combine manufacturing knowledge, modern recruiting technology and persistent search work to help good companies hire good people. 01 Manufacturing Focus We stay close to the roles, skills and environments we know instead of pretending to be experts in every industry under the sun. 02 Straight Answers If a search is difficult, we say so. If a candidate is not right, we say so. If we think there is a better path, we explain it. 03 People Before Fees A placement only counts as a win when it is a good decision for both sides. We will walk away from money before we knowingly push a bad fit. “Do the right thing, put good people at great companies, and build something we can be proud to put our family name behind.” That standard affects who we work with, who we recommend and how we handle every search. Need manufacturing talent? Tell us what you are trying to solve. We will tell you how we can help — and which search structure makes the most sense. Start a Conversation →
